text.p: Arcadian Corp said on Monday that it sees a "very promising" fourth quarter and 1997 fiscal year.

Earlier in the day, the company reported third quarter earnings of $0.51 per share, down from $0.59 in the year-ago quarter. It reported nine-month earnings of $2.49, up from the year-ago figure of $2.37.
It attributed third quarter results to lower product prices and higher natural gas costs.
The nitrogen fertilizer and chemical maker said higher nine-month figures resulted from strategy that indexes a significant portion of natural gas costs to the price of ammonia.

"With the recent improvement in ammonia prices, price stability of urea and nitrogen solutions and the continued fundamental strength of the nitrogen industry, the fourth quarter and 1997 look very promising," the company stated.
